{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZf5oGQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDHDqE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 53, "title": "Implement math-disabled SETINI pseudo-hires while preserving low-resolution BG addressing", "body": "## Problem

SETINI `$2133` bit 3 currently has no rendering effect. `Ppu::hires()` checks only BGMODE 5/6, and that predicate controls framebuffer width, BG character width, horizontal scroll scaling, screen sampling and output selection. Simply adding SETINI to this predicate would incorrectly give low-resolution backgrounds Mode 5/6 addressing.

This is the bounded hardware implementation recommended by the latest assessment. The supplied snapshot lists no open Issues, and completed Issues #49 and #51 explicitly leave pseudo-hires outstanding.

## Expected outcome

Implement non-interlaced, non-mosaic pseudo-hires output with color math and color-window clipping disabled. Separate output resolution from background addressing.

### Hardware contract and evidence boundary

Use [Anomie's Register Doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gilligan/snesdev/master/docs/snes_registers.txt), revision 1157, sections `$2133`, Modes 5/6, BG Scrolling and Color Math, together with [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm), sections SETINI, CGRAM and TM/TS. Their versions, hashes and relevant interpretations are recorded in the repository's [Issue #49 specification record](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/docs/issue-49-validation.md#specification-contract-recorded-before-implementation).

Within the stated register domain:

- Output uses 512 horizontal samples when BGMODE is 5/6 **or** SETINI bit 3 is set. Setting both does not double the width again.
- For pseudo-hires in low-resolution modes, output sample `2*x` displays the subscreen at full-dot coordinate `x`; sample `2*x+1` displays the mainscreen at that same coordinate. TM/TS select their layers independently.
- SETINI changes output selection, not BG character dimensions, scroll units, map addressing, Mode 2/4 offset coordinates or Mode 7 transform coordinates. Ordinary Mode 5/6 retain their distinct even/odd character samples.
- Transparent BG index zero remains transparent. The documented composition contract uses CGRAM[0] for the main backdrop and COLDATA for the sub backdrop. Check the cited source sections before adopting these existing expectations as new test oracles.
- Layer-window coordinates remain full dots. TMW and TSW independently mask their respective screen's layers.
- INIDISP brightness affects both displayed phases; forced blank produces black across the current packed row. The existing BGR555-to-RGBA conversion remains a software representation convention, not a measured analog DAC model.

**Unresolved specification conflict:** Issue #49 records conflicting Fullsnes and Anomie descriptions of hires addition/subtraction. It contains neither a reconciliation nor sufficient source excerpts to establish complete pseudo-hires color math or color-window clipping. This read-only evaluation inspected repository records only. Do not treat the renderer's current `!visible_sub` math gate or its clipping behavior as authoritative. This Issue's pixel contract uses `CGADSUB=$00` and CGWSEL clipping disabled; enabling pseudo-hires must not be reported as resolving the disputed interactions. If checking the cited specifications disproves an in-scope predecessor requirement, correct that requirement and its tests with explicit attribution rather than preserving it solely because it passes.

### Scope and non-goals

Implement output selection, independent low-resolution coordinates, TM/TS composition, layer-window routing, backdrops, brightness, forced blank and packed-buffer transitions. Exercise representative planar modes, Mode 2/4 offsets, an identity Mode 7 scene and a simple OBJ routing control.

Retain the existing frame storage policy: promote to 512 samples when a wide row is encountered, duplicate previously stored low-resolution dots, keep the promoted width for the frame, and allow shrinking at the next low-resolution row zero. This policy does not establish physical mode-switch timing.

Remaining work includes math-enabled pseudo-hires, color-window clipping/prevention interactions, ordinary-hires composition accuracy, mosaic, complete OBJ behavior, interlace/overscan, pixel-fetch arbitration and mid-scanline switching. No raster pipeline, frontend redesign, PAL support or enhancement-chip work belongs here.

## Context and reproduction

Baseline: `06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35`.

Relevant implementation and tests:

- [ppu.rs](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/crates/snes-core/src/ppu.rs): `hires`, `bg_tile_width`, `bg_source`, `prepare_frame_width`, `render_line`.
- [ppu_hires.rs](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/crates/snes-core/tests/ppu_hires.rs): ordinary-hires phases, geometry, backdrops and transitions.
- [Original CPU fixture builder](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/crates/snes-core/tests/common/hires.rs) and [Wasm/canvas checks](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/web/tests/hires.spec.js).
- [Mode 6 offset contract and regressions](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/docs/issue-51-validation.md).

Reproduce with an original Mode 1 scene: BG1 red on TM, BG2 blue on TS, full brightness, no mosaic, no color math or clipping. Render with SETINI `$00`, then `$08` while leaving BGMODE unchanged.

Current result: both configurations remain 256 samples wide and display only the main result. Expected pseudo-hires result: 512×224 packed RGBA with blue/red pairs. Use nonuniform graphics and distinct backdrops in further vectors so duplication, swapped phases and doubled source coordinates cannot accidentally pass.

No tests were rerun during this planning evaluation.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record the in-scope source-derived rules before fixing expected pixels, identifying source versions/sections, derivations, representation policies and unresolved claims. Explicitly retain the hires-math dispute as unresolved unless additional documented evidence actually settles it. Correct any disproved in-scope predecessor contract with evidence.
- [ ] Implement independent predicates or equivalent clear logic for 512-sample output and Mode 5/6 BG addressing. SETINI bit 3 enables pseudo-hires; clearing it restores compact low-resolution output at the appropriate frame boundary. Other SETINI bits do not accidentally enable horizontal expansion, and Modes 5/6 remain 512 samples with bit 3 clear or set.
- [ ] Add original independent numerical tests in `ppu_pseudo_hires.rs`. Cover all four TM/TS enabled/disabled combinations with distinguishable main/sub backdrops; transparent versus opaque black pixels; nonuniform adjacent source pixels; scroll and tile boundaries; both image edges; layer-window boundaries and independent TMW/TSW routing; representative BG/OBJ priority selection; brightness zero/reduced/full; and forced blank. Include low-resolution mode controls, Mode 2/4 offset boundaries and identity Mode 7. Expected pixels must come from literal vectors or an independent coordinate oracle, not production rendering helpers.
- [ ] Demonstrate baseline counterexamples: the unchanged baseline must fail new pseudo-hires width and phase assertions, while a low-resolution control passes. Record commands and observed failures without altering expected results to fit either implementation.
- [ ] Add bounded original CPU-executed guests that initialize registers, VRAM and CGRAM through CPU bus writes. Cover static enable/disable and controller-driven VBlank SETINI transitions while BGMODE stays fixed. Assert completion markers, exact dimensions/length and literal pixels. Host code may provide cartridges and controller input, not patch guest machine state. Document original code/data and MIT provenance in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`; commit no generated ROM or firmware.
- [ ] Verify packed 256→512→256 frame transitions, mixed rows, forced blank, reset and cartridge replacement. Extend actual Wasm/canvas tests using the original guest to assert phase pixels, dimensions, buffer length, both edges and the final row. Preserve existing memory-view reacquisition and display-shape checks. Verify runner PPM dimensions and payload for the new fixture.
- [ ] Pass the commands below, preserving existing Mode 2/4/6 offsets, ordinary hires, direct color, CPU/SPC/HDMA gates and cleared-game regressions. Keep fixture pins, hashes, replay inputs, durations, audio/gameplay assertions and negative controls intact. Record actual failures, skips and unperformed checks; mandatory checks must pass before merge.

```sh
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --locked
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_pseudo_hires --test ppu_hires --test ppu_offset --test ppu_mode6_offset --test direct_color
python3 tools/make-fixture.py .cache/smoke.bin
cmp tests/roms/smoke.bin .cache/smoke.bin
python3 tools/build-test-tools.py --spc
python3 tools/hardware-tests.py --ca65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ca65" --ld65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ld65" --spcasm "$PWD/.cache/tools/spcasm/target/release/spcasm"
python3 tools/ppu-test.py --bass "$PWD/.cache/tools/bass-untech/bass/out/bass-untech"
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
npm --prefix web ci
npm --prefix web run build
(cd web && npx playwright install chromium)
npm --prefix web test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'
```

Use the documented compiler/alternate-port environment settings if needed. These commands are implementation acceptance requirements, not claims of execution by this evaluator. Source-built external fixtures must retain the repository's [provenance and alterations](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/06e295b62340b3052002de517a77de588177ed35/tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md).

- [ ] Update README and validation evidence with the exact supported register domain and remaining limitations. Preserve all 24 inventory categories and their full scopes: `cpu`, `bus`, `scheduler`, `dma`, `hdma`, `controllers`, `ppu-bg`, `ppu-offset`, `ppu-hires`, `ppu-mode7`, `ppu-objects`, `ppu-color`, `ppu-ports`, `ppu-raster`, `ppu-display`, `spc`, `ipl`, `dsp-voices`, `dsp-noise`, `dsp-pitch`, `dsp-envelope`, `dsp-echo`, `dsp-timing`, `pal`. This bounded improvement does not make any category verified, complete Issue #3, or establish commercial compatibility.

## Optional validation

Additional original static scenes within the documented register domain. No commercial ROM acquisition or physical-device testing is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
